pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron,
And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron,
dicens:
saying:
Singuli per turmas,
“Each one shall make camp,
signa,
by their troops,
atque vexilla,
as well as by their insignia
et domos cognationum suarum,
and standards,
castrametabuntur filii Israël,
and by the houses of their kinships,
per gyrum tabernaculi fœderis.
all around the tabernacle of the covenant.”
Ad orientem Judas figet tentoria per turmas exercitus sui:
To the east, Judah shall fix his tents, by the companies of his army.
eritque princeps filiorum ejus Nahasson filius Aminadab.
And the leader of his sons shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Et omnis de stirpe ejus summa pugnantium, septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.
And the entire total of the fighting men from his stock was seventy-four thousand six hundred.
Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Issachar,
Beside him, those of the tribe of Issachar were encamped,
quorum princeps fuit Nathanaël filius Suar.
whose leader was Nathanael the son of Zuar.
Et omnis numerus pugnatorum ejus quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
And the entire number of his fighting men was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
In tribu Zabulon princeps fuit Eliab filius Helon.
In the tribe of Zebulon, the leader was Eliab the son of Helon.
Omnis de stirpe ejus exercitus pugnatorum, quinquaginta septem millia quadringenti.
All the army of fighting men from his stock were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
Universi qui in castris Judæ enumerati sunt, fuerunt centum octoginta sex millia quadringenti:
All who were numbered in the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. And these,
et per turmas suas primi egredientur.
by their companies, shall go forth first.
In castris filiorum Ruben ad meridianam plagam erit princeps Elisur filius Sedeur.
In the camp of the sons of Ruben, toward the south side, the leader shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt,
And the entire army of his fighting men, who were numbered,
quadraginta sex millia quingenti.
were forty-six thousand five hundred.
Juxta eum castrametati sunt de tribu Simeon:
Beside him, those of the tribe of Simeon were encamped,
quorum princeps fuit Salamiel filius Surisaddai.
whose leader was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus qui numerati sunt,
And the entire army of his fighting men, who were numbered,
quinquaginta novem millia trecenti.
were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
In tribu Gad princeps fuit Eliasaph filius Duel.
In the tribe of Gad, the leader was Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
And the entire army of his fighting men,
qui numerati sunt,
who were numbered,
quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti quinquaginta.
were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Omnes qui recensiti sunt in castris Ruben,
All who were counted in the camp of Ruben were one hundred fifty thousand and one thousand four hundred fifty,
centum quinquaginta millia et mille quadringenti quinquaginta per turmas suas:
by their companies.
in secundo loco proficiscentur.
These shall advance in the second place.
Levabitur autem tabernaculum testimonii per officia Levitarum, et turmas eorum:
But the tabernacle of the testimony shall be lifted up by the officers of the Levites and their companies.
quomodo erigetur,
In the manner in which it is set up,
ita et deponetur.
so also shall it be taken down.
Singuli per loca et ordines suos proficiscentur.
Each one shall advance according to their places and ranks.
Ad occidentalem plagam erunt castra filiorum Ephraim,
On the west side, there shall be the camp of the sons of Ephraim,
quorum princeps fuit Elisama filius Ammiud.
whose leader was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
The entire army of his fighting men,
qui numerati sunt,
who were numbered,
quadraginta millia quingenti.
were forty thousand five hundred.
Et cum eis tribus filiorum Manasse,
And with them was the tribe of the sons of Manasseh,
quorum princeps fuit Gamaliel filius Phadassur.
whose leader was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Cunctusque exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
And the entire army of his fighting men,
qui numerati sunt,
who were numbered,
triginta duo millia ducenti.
were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
In tribu filiorum Benjamin princeps fuit Abidan filius Gedeonis.
In the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, the leader was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Et cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
And the entire army of his fighting men,
qui recensiti sunt,
who were counted,
triginta quinque millia quadringenti.
were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Ephraim,
All who were numbered in the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred,
centum octo millia centum per turmas suas:
by their companies.
tertii proficiscentur.
These shall advance third.
Ad aquilonis partem castrametati sunt filii Dan:
Toward the north side, the sons of Dan were encamped,
quorum princeps fuit Ahiezer filius Ammisaddai.
whose leader was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
The entire army of his fighting men,
qui numerati sunt,
who were numbered,
sexaginta duo millia septingenti.
were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
Juxta eum fixere tentoria de tribu Aser:
Beside him, those of the tribe of Asher fixed their tents,
quorum princeps fuit Phegiel filius Ochran.
whose leader was Pagiel the son of Ochran.
Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus,
The entire army of his fighting men,
qui numerati sunt,
who were numbered,
quadraginta millia et mille quingenti.
were forty thousand and one thousand five hundred.
De tribu filiorum Nephthali princeps fuit Ahira filius Enan.
From the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, the leader was Ahira the son of Enan.
Cunctus exercitus pugnatorum ejus, quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.
The entire army of his fighting men were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Omnes qui numerati sunt in castris Dan, fuerunt centum quinquaginta septem millia sexcenti:
All who were numbered in the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred;
et novissimi proficiscentur.
and these shall advance at the very end.
Hic numerus filiorum Israël,
This is the number of the sons of Israel,
per domos cognationum suarum et turmas divisi exercitus,
of their army divided by the houses of their kinships and their companies:
sexcenta tria millia quingenti quinquaginta.
six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Levitæ autem non sunt numerati inter filios Israël:
But the Levites were not numbered among the sons of Israel.
sic enim præceperat Dominus Moysi.
For so the Lord had instructed Moses.
Feceruntque filii Israël juxta omnia quæ mandaverat Dominus.
And the sons of Israel acted according to all the things that the Lord had commanded.
Castrametati sunt per turmas suas,
They were encamped by their companies,
et profecti per familias ac domos patrum suorum.
and they advanced by the families and houses of their fathers.
